usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations with JSON body {"model":"bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast","prompt":"<text>"} (x402 USDC on Base). Returns 202 queued job; then GET the returned poll_url (x402-paid, same wallet) until status=completed.
usage.outputShape: Submit (202): body.id (jobId), body.status="queued", body.poll_url. Completed poll (200): body.status="completed", body.data[0].url (mp4, blockrun-hosted) and body.data[0].source_url (CDN, signed/expiring), body.payment.status="settled", body.payment.tx_hash.
quirks: PRICE IS DURATION-BASED, NOT the $0.15 registry surface: a 5s clip cost $1.19. Quote scales with duration_seconds (default 5s).
Async two-step: POST returns 202 with status=queued + a poll_url. You MUST poll poll_url (GET) to get the video.

poll_url is relative to https://blockrun.ai and is x402-paid: GET it with an x-payment header signed by the SAME wallet that did the POST (a fresh signature is fine; it enforces wallet binding, not byte-equality). The poll endpoint returns its own 402 challenge so x402 clients auto re-sign.

In-progress polls return HTTP 202 with note 'No charge until status=completed' and DO NOT settle a payment. Only the completed poll (HTTP 200) settles. Net result: ONE charge (~$1.19 for 5s), on completion.
Completed video lives at body.data[0].url; source_url is a CDN link with an expiring signature.
managed/x402 wallet identity matters: poll must come from the same wallet as the submit, or it will not return the job.
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations with JSON {"model":"bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast","prompt":"..."} paying x402 USDC on Base. You get back HTTP 202 with a job id and a relative poll_url. GET that poll_url (prefix https://blockrun.ai) repeatedly with an x402 payment signed by the same wallet; while generating it returns 202 (no charge yet). When it returns 200 with status=completed, read the video at body.data[0].url (or expiring CDN body.data[0].source_url). Charged once on completion; price scales with clip duration (~$1.19 for default 5s).
